directions.name: 流线 J
directions.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: one original personal logo concept, flat vector-like presentation.
Design an exceptionally refined original wordmark using the exact text "Jacob" (capital J followed by lowercase a c o b), for an individual Chinese product designer and AI product engineer. This is a personal identity, thoughtful and capable, with an understated contemporary creative-studio character.
Direction: flowing J. Create custom lettering, an upright medium-bold geometric/humanist sans serif with very precise optical spacing, a distinctive broad curved lower hook on the J, and open, clean rounded counters in a, c, o, b. One tiny diagonal terminal or separated acid-lime stroke at the top of the J gives it a recognizable signature; integrate it into the actual letter construction. The rest of the word is warm white. Legibility of the exact word "Jacob" is essential. The mark must work in one color as well.
Composition: landscape 3:2 board, uniform very dark navy background #05090d, generous negative space, a single large horizontal Jacob wordmark centered in the upper-middle. Below it, one small standalone J monogram, derived exactly from the wordmark's J, shows the avatar/favicon potential. Keep the two elements balanced and restrained.
Palette: warm white #f0f4f3 plus a tiny acid-lime #d8fa45 accent. Sharp solid vector-like edges, truly flat fills.
Avoid: any text besides the one word Jacob; no slogans, labels, numbers, Chinese text, registration or copyright symbols; no stock fonts left unmodified; no robot, AI brain, circuit motif, arrow icon, star icon, orbit rings, generic tech-company symbol, 3D, gradients, glow, texture, shadows, stationery mockups or photographs. Deliver clean logo artwork.

directions.name: 几何字标
directions.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: one original personal logo concept, flat vector-like presentation.
Create a distinctive, impeccably crafted custom wordmark reading exactly "Jacob" (capital J, lowercase a c o b), a personal identity for a product designer who turns business questions into working digital products using design and AI collaboration.
Direction: architectural geometry. Design compact upright bold lettering with a square-shouldered J, slightly rounded outer corners, geometric open lowercase forms, and carefully controlled negative space. Introduce one subtle, consistent 35-degree cut in the upper J terminal and the b terminal, making the lettering proprietary without sacrificing readability. The identity should feel precise, quiet, practical and contemporary, not futuristic or aggressive. Derive a simple standalone J from the lettering.
Composition: wide landscape 3:2 board, a plain dark navy #05090d background. One large horizontal Jacob wordmark centered above the midline, with one much smaller standalone J monogram below. Broad margins and thoughtful optical balance; no decorative elements.
Palette: the primary wordmark in warm white #f0f4f3 with a single small cyan #66d8f4 terminal detail. The small J monogram can be solid cyan. Flat, crisp, vector-like fills that can also work in one color and at small sizes.
Text accuracy: show Jacob exactly once. No additional words or typography.
Avoid: generic corporate emblems, bracket/code icons, arrows, circuitry, robot motifs, stars, circles enclosing the logo, registered symbols, logo grids, 3D, gradients, lighting effects, glow, texture, shadows and mockups.

directions.name: 签名字标
directions.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: one original personal wordmark concept, flat vector-like presentation.
Design an original, mature and exceptionally clean personal signature logo reading exactly "Jacob", capital J followed by lowercase a c o b. The owner is a product designer and AI product engineer, and the identity should emphasize the human author behind thoughtful digital products.
Direction: a refined signature drawn by a skilled lettering artist. Use a broad, confident continuous stroke with restrained calligraphic variation, a beautifully readable capital J, clear a/c/o/b letterforms, and natural rhythm. Slight forward energy, not a cursive wedding script. Keep the J's lower hook and the final b's finish compact and purposeful. It should feel warm, intelligent, self-assured and personal while remaining practical for a website header. Make it readable at small size, with no hairline flourishes or tangled ligatures. Below the wordmark show a smaller standalone J gesture that is visibly derived from the same J.
Composition: wide landscape 3:2 logo board. Uniform near-black navy background #05090d, single large Jacob signature centered in the upper-middle, small standalone J centered beneath, plenty of empty space. Main lettering warm white #f0f4f3; use at most one tiny acid-lime #d8fa45 terminal accent on the small J. No extra decorative shapes.
Use only exact text "Jacob" once. Flat solid colors, clean vector-like edges, no texture.
Avoid: slogans, labels, numbers, Chinese text, registration symbols, illegible handwriting, ornamental underlines, loops encircling the name, stock font appearance, paint splatter, pen photographs, mockups, shadows, glow, gradients and 3D.
